parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Start of the reporting period (inclusive). Only the date part is considered.

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: End of the reporting period (inclusive). Only the date part is considered. Must be greater than or equal to `fromDate`, and the range cannot exceed 366 days.

parameters.name: paymentMode
parameters.description: Filter by payment mode. When omitted, wallet recharges are excluded and only payments are aggregated.

parameters.name: groupBy
parameters.description: How rows are grouped. Repeat the parameter to group by more than one dimension (e.g. `groupBy=Store&groupBy=Company`). When omitted, rows are aggregated per PaymentGateway only.

items.description: A grouping dimension for volumes report rows. `All` aggregates per PaymentGateway only; `Store` additionally breaks the rows down per Store; `Company` additionally breaks the rows down per Company.
items.title: Reports.RevenuesGrouping

parameters.name: paymentGatewayIds
parameters.description: Filter by one or more PaymentGateway identifiers. Repeat the parameter to provide multiple values.

parameters.name: storeIds
parameters.description: Filter by one or more Store identifiers. Repeat the parameter to provide multiple values.

parameters.name: companyIds
parameters.description: Filter by one or more Company identifiers. Repeat the parameter to provide multiple values.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: A cursor for pagination across multiple pages of results. Don’t include this parameter on the first call. Use the `nextStart` value returned in a previous response to request subsequent results.
